translation: Gomme Yosefa a gana botlale ⟨את⟩ bana ba kgole khutšo e nnyane — ruri a gana botlale bjo botele bja kgole — gomme a gana ⟨את⟩ bana bjo bongwe bja kgole botlale (bjo bo sa ganelwago ka botlalo gore ke bjo bongwe le bjo bongwe fela), a gana ⟨את⟩ bana ba kgole ka moka ka gano la bja kgole — eupša ka nnete, a gana botlale bja kgole ⟨את⟩ bana bja yena ka moka, gomme a lela go feta bjo; gomme ka morago ga moo bana bja yena ba bolela le yena ⟨את⟩.

tokens.gloss: ba bangoe ba kgole ka moka — eupša ka nnete bja yena ka moka
bana bja yena ba kgole ba nnyane, ka moka, bja ba bangwe le bja yena
ka gano la bja kgole e nnyane
bana bja yena ba kgole botlale
